deleteData.title: Delete my data
deleteData.intro: If you signed up early, Playlink only keeps your email address, your language and the sign-up date — to tell you when the app launches, nothing else.
deleteData.how: To delete them, email us from that address: we’ll erase your sign-up and confirm it.
deleteData.mailBody:
Hello,

Please delete my Playlink early sign-up (the address this email is sent from).
deleteData.delay: We reply within 30 days at most, as required by the GDPR. Address: {email}.
